claims.content: The Auctioneer wants to edit or remove an existing auction by managing auction event profiles.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The Auctioneer wants to edit or remove an existing auction by managing auction event profiles.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: The Auctioneer edits an existing auction's auction event profile settings to the desired values.
scope_contract.start_boundary: The Auctioneer decides to edit an existing auction.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The selected existing auction has been edited as intended.

claims.content: Auctioneer
The Auctioneer is logged into the system and has access to the Auction Administration workspace, including the Create / Edit Auction Event Profiles page.
An auction event profile that the Auctioneer previously created already exists.
The Auctioneer navigates to 'THE VIEW / EDIT CURRENT & SCHEDULED AUCTIONS PAGE' (Section 9.9) to edit or remove an existing auction.
The Auctioneer navigates from the Auction Admin Main Menu Page to the View / Edit Current & Scheduled Auctions page via the Administration Menu Section link.
The Auctioneer uses the Search Section to locate the auction to edit by entering criteria such as Product ID, Customer Email, Date Range, Cost Range, or Product Type, and clicks 'Find Product'.
The system displays the matching auction items in the Search Results Section, including a 'Choose All' checkbox under the Action column.
The Auctioneer selects the auction items to edit by checking them, or uses the 'Choose All' checkbox to select all items.
The Auctioneer selects one existing event profile from the list box of available event profiles.
The Auctioneer clicks the 'Apply' button.

The system applies the selected event profile to all selected auction items; alternatively, for removal, when the Auctioneer selects 'Remove checked items from this auction' from the scrolling 'Action' list box and clicks the 'Apply Changes' button, the system removes the selected auction items from the auction.

Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Remove checked items from this auction' from the scrolling Action list box to remove the selected existing auction items.
Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Edit bid increments' from the scrolling Action list box to edit bid increments for the selected auction items.
Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Edit reserve amounts' from the scrolling Action list box to edit reserve amounts for the selected auction items.

Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Edit durations' from the scrolling Action list box and chooses a standard auction duration (e.g., 20-Minute, 1-hour, 1 Day, 30 Day) for the selected auction group.

Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Edit durations' from the scrolling Action list box and schedules an alternative duration by manually choosing starting and ending dates/times.

Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Apply ending time to all' from the scrolling Action list box and chooses the ending time from a dropdown list in the column header.

Diverges from Step 5: instead of selecting an event profile, the Auctioneer selects 'Apply starting time to all' from the scrolling Action list box and chooses the starting time from a dropdown list in the column header.

missing_aspects: execution or confirmation behavior after selecting an Action list box option
The cited evidence does not specify that the dropdown is located specifically in the 'ending time column' header, only generally in the 'column header'.
The cited evidence does not specify that the dropdown is located specifically in the 'starting time column' header, only generally in the 'column header'.

claims.content: At Step 5, if the Auctioneer attempts to select more than one event profile from the list box, the system constrains the selection to no more than one.

At Step 6, if the Auctioneer tries to apply an event profile restricted to a specific category to a grouping that includes items from a different category, the system generates an error message stating that the profile can only be applied to products in the restricted category (for example, the gemstone category).

missing_aspects: Exit or recovery path after multiple-profile selection is prevented is not specified.
Exit or recovery path after the category-restricted profile error is not specified.
The cited evidence confirms the constraint but does not describe the specific user interaction (e.g., UI behavior) that occurs when an attempt is made to select multiple profiles.

claims.content: When the Auctioneer edits an existing auction by applying a selected event profile, the system applies the profile settings (including cost tiers, opening bids, bid increments, durations, and product eligibility constraints) to the targeted auction items, updating them with the new parameters.
When the Auctioneer removes an existing auction, the selected items are successfully removed from the auction.
